question: How long do I have to return a laptop I bought?
expected_answer: 30 days from delivery; 60 days for Altura Plus members.

question: I returned my headphones last week. When will I get my money back on my credit card?
expected_answer: The refund is issued within 3 business days of the return arriving; card refunds then take 5 to 10 business days to appear.

question: How much does next-day delivery cost and what is the order cut-off?
expected_answer: $24.99; orders must be placed before 2 p.m. local time Monday to Friday.

question: My tracking number has not updated in a week. What should I do?
expected_answer: If tracking has not updated for 5 business days contact support with the order number so a trace is opened with the carrier.

question: I see two charges on my card for the same order. Was I charged twice?
expected_answer: A pending authorization hold can appear next to the real charge and drops off in 3 to 7 business days; two completed charges should be reported with the order number and card details and are refunded within 5 business days.

question: Can I still cancel my order? I placed it 30 minutes ago.
expected_answer: Yes. Orders can be cancelled free within 1 hour or while the status is Received from Account > Orders > Cancel order.

question: How long is the password reset link valid?
expected_answer: 30 minutes.

question: My account is locked after too many sign-in attempts. How long do I have to wait?
expected_answer: After 5 failed attempts the account is locked for 15 minutes; resetting the password unlocks it immediately.

question: How much does Altura Plus cost?
expected_answer: $9.99 per month or $99 per year.

question: If I cancel my monthly Altura Plus membership do I get a refund for the rest of the month?
expected_answer: No. Partial months are not refunded; benefits continue until the end of the billing period.

question: Does the warranty cover a cracked screen after I dropped my phone?
expected_answer: No. Accidental damage is not covered by the warranty; it is only covered by an Altura Care plan.

question: What is the service fee for an accidental damage claim with Altura Care?
expected_answer: $49 per accidental damage claim; up to 2 claims per year.

question: Do you ship to Canada and who pays the import duties?
expected_answer: Yes. Delivery takes 7 to 14 business days and the customer pays duties and taxes to the carrier on delivery.

question: Can I use two promo codes on one order?
expected_answer: No. Only one promo code can be used per order.

question: The price of my TV dropped a week after it was delivered. Can I get the difference back?
expected_answer: Yes. A one-time price adjustment is available within 14 days of delivery and refunded to the original payment method.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
expected_answer: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and Altura gift cards; no cash on delivery, checks or bank transfers.

question: How do I get an invoice that shows my company VAT number?
expected_answer: Add the company name and VAT ID in the Business details section at checkout before placing the order.

question: My package shows as delivered but I cannot find it. What should I do?
expected_answer: Wait 48 hours, check with neighbors and reception, then file a claim within 30 days of the delivery date.

question: My new speaker arrived in a dented box and does not turn on. What should I do?
expected_answer: Report shipping damage within 7 days of delivery with photos of the item and box and keep the packaging.

question: What are your phone support hours?
expected_answer: Monday to Friday 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. ET and Saturday and Sunday 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET; live chat is available 24/7.

question: How long does a trade-in quote stay valid?
expected_answer: 14 days.

question: How long will a pickup point hold my order?
expected_answer: 7 days, after which it is returned and fully refunded.

question: Do you sell my personal data to other companies?
expected_answer: No. Altura does not sell personal data to third parties.
